description: Extreme fear (F&G<20) is capitulation; contrarian long for 14d as sellers exhaust
Low implied vol (DVOL in bottom 30% of 180d) in an uptrend = calm grind, trend continuation; long BTC
MVRV below 1 means market trades under aggregate cost basis: capitulation zone, historically the accumulation window; long
Time-series momentum: BTC above its 90-day mean keeps trending; long
Time-series momentum: BTC below its 90-day mean keeps falling; short
MVRV z-score 365 above 0 with up/range trend: holders in growing unrealised profit vs the year norm is the healthy bull-market state, not yet euphoria; long with trend
MVRV above 3 is euphoria: holders sit on 200% aggregate profit and distribute; short
ETH MVRV below 1: market under aggregate cost basis, capitulation, accumulate; long
ETH MVRV above 2.5 marks euphoria and distribution by profitable holders; short
Liquidity tide: stablecoin supply growing over 30d (roc>0) while trend is up or range means new dollars arriving to bid BTC
Greed in an uptrend is momentum not a top: F&G>=60 with trend up keeps running
Vol spike = capitulation: BTC DVOL 30d z-score >= 2 in down/range marks forced selling; long the rebound
Low implied vol with no regime gate: test where compression pays for a BTC long across all regimes (first test showed uptrend loses)
High implied vol level (top 30% of 180d) ungated: fear premium is paid to longs; see which regime carries it
Vol targeting: long BTC only in an up trend while 30d realised vol is in the lower half of its 1y range; calm uptrends have small drawdowns
Exhaustion short: BTC 14d RSI overbought while trend regime is down or range; rallies in a non-uptrend fade
Vol targeting ETH: long only in an up trend while 30d realised vol of daily log returns is under 4%; calm uptrends
Exhaustion short ETH: 14d RSI overbought while trend regime is down or range
Uptrend greed momentum, only while stablecoin supply is growing over 30d: liquidity confirms the bid, exits when dollars stop arriving
Liquidity tide in uptrend only: stablecoin 30d growth positive, trend up; drop range where it earned little and drew down
Uptrend momentum but avoid euphoria: greed 60+ yet below 80 (extreme greed is where blowoffs draw down)
High implied vol in up/range only: elevated vol in a non-downtrend is demand for upside calls and a paid risk premium; down regime was weakest so gate it out
Short BTC when implied vol is compressed (bottom 30% of 180d): complacency, nobody hedged, and low-vol periods in 2021-24 drifted lower; all regimes lost for the long
ETH long on high ETH implied vol (top 30% of 180d): same fear/risk premium idea as BTC, ungated to read the regime table
ETH short on compressed ETH implied vol (bottom 30% of 180d): complacency and drift lower in quiet tape, ungated to read regimes
ETH below aggregate cost basis is a discount, but catching it in a downtrend costs drawdown; take the discount only once price trend has turned up or range
BTC: holders still in aggregate profit (MVRV>=1.5) while the trend is already down means unrealised profit left to be distributed into weakness; short in downtrend
ETH: holders still in aggregate profit (MVRV>=1.5) while trend is down means profit left to distribute; short in downtrend
BTC miner capitulation: miner revenue deeply below its 90d norm (z<-1) while MVRV is low (<1.2) marks forced miner selling exhaustion near bottoms; long
Breakout momentum: BTC 14d RSI at 65+ signals strong buying pressure that persists for days; long while it lasts, short holding periods cap drawdown
Fast trend filter: long BTC in up regime only while price is above its 20d mean, so the rule exits early in pullbacks and limits drawdown
Breakout momentum ETH: 14d RSI at 65+ signals persistent buying pressure; long while it lasts
Breakdown short: BTC 14d RSI under 35 in a down regime means sellers in control and the slide continues
Breakdown short ETH: 14d RSI under 35 in a down regime means sellers in control and the slide continues
Extreme fear (F&G<25) in a range regime: panic without a downtrend is a washout that mean-reverts; exp1 showed range earns, down does not
Greed momentum in uptrend with 90d stablecoin growth positive: slower liquidity tide filters late-cycle rallies on shrinking dollars
ETH deep discount: MVRV<1 with MVRV no longer falling over 30d (roc>=0) means capitulation selling has stopped and cost basis is being reclaimed; long
BTC bear market proper: MVRV under 1.5 (no profit cushion) in a downtrend with active addresses below their 90d norm (z<0) means demand has left; short
BTC value zone plus trend confirmation: MVRV<1.2 (near cost basis) taken only when trend is up or range, i.e. the recovery out of capitulation; long
ETH short: fee pressure collapsing (fees z90 < -1) in a downtrend means blockspace demand has evaporated, no bid behind price; short
ETH long on high ETH implied vol only in an uptrend: range lost money, so gate by regime; rising-vol uptrends are call-buying breakouts
ETH short on compressed ETH vol gated to up/range: quiet rallies without option demand fade; down regime lost so gate it out
BTC short on compressed vol that is still falling (pctile<0.3 and 30d roc<0): complacency deepening; second condition should cut exposure and drawdown
BTC long when implied vol is rising fast (30d roc >= 0.2) in up/range: vol expansion in a non-downtrend is upside demand, a dynamic version of the high-pctile rule
Uptrend plus sentiment not fearful (F&G>=50): broader momentum participation than 60, earlier entry into trends
Greed momentum with accelerating liquidity: stablecoin cap above its 90d average by 2%+ (supply expanding fast) in an uptrend
BTC short: fear in a downtrend is trend continuation not capitulation (exp1: fear lost in down); F&G<40 with trend down
BTC short: stablecoin supply contracting over 30d (dollars leaving) in a downtrend removes the bid
RSI breakout made its money in up regime (Sharpe 3.4) and lost in down; gate to up only to cut the drawdown from counter-trend spikes
Failed relief rally: in a down regime, RSI recovered to neutral (45-60) means the bounce has used up its fuel and the trend resumes; short
Exhaustion: ETH 7d move of +2 sigma or more (vchg) outside an uptrend is a squeeze that retraces; short in down or range
ETH RSI breakout made most of its money in up regime; gate to up only to reduce drawdown
BTC under cost basis and MVRV no longer falling over 30d: capitulation selling exhausted, cost basis being reclaimed; long (same logic that held on ETH)
BTC fee spike (fees z90>=2) marks blockspace mania and late retail demand, which has coincided with local tops; short
ETH discount recovering, taken only in an uptrend where the earlier test showed the cleanest returns, to cut the drawdown from range chop
ETH: any aggregate profit cushion left (MVRV>=1.2) in a downtrend still gets distributed; a lower round threshold gives more days than 1.5 to check the idea is not a small-sample fluke
BTC short: extreme greed (F&G>=75) with stablecoin supply shrinking over 30d: euphoria with no new dollars is a top
BTC short: complacency in a downtrend - F&G>=50 while trend is down is a bear-market rally that sentiment has not priced; fade it
BTC short: DeFi TVL down 20%+ over 30d is deleveraging and risk-off; in a downtrend the unwind continues
BTC short: sentiment collapsing from a high - F&G well below its 30d average (ma_ratio<0.7) while not yet in a downtrend marks the break of a greedy market
BTC short on compressed and still-falling vol, downtrend only: quiet bleed with no hedging demand continues; down regime had the best Sharpe and gating should cut the bull-market drawdown
BTC short when implied vol spikes (30d z >= 1) inside a downtrend: the spike long lost badly in down, so a vol jump there is the start of liquidation, not the end
ETH short when ETH implied vol spikes (30d z >= 1) inside a downtrend: vol expansion in a downtrend is liquidation continuing
BTC long when implied vol is 1 sigma above its 90d mean in up/range: vol expansion outside a downtrend is upside chase; z is a level-free version of the pctile rule
ETH long when ETH implied vol is 1 sigma above its 90d mean in up/range: same vol-expansion-outside-downtrend idea that worked on BTC, applied to ETH own vol
ETH short in a downtrend while BTC implied vol is compressed and falling: market-wide complacency during a bleed (BTC vol leads the complex); the BTC version kept
BTC short on compressed vol in a downtrend, single condition (simpler than the kept two-condition rule): quiet bleed continues
ETH long when BTC implied vol expands (z90 >= 1) in ETH up/range: BTC vol is the complex-wide risk-appetite gauge and ETH is the higher-beta follower
BTC fee spike as late-demand top marker lost only in uptrends (momentum overrides); gate to range/down where a fee mania is a blow-off without trend support; short
Puell-multiple style: miner revenue under half its 365d average means miner income stress and capitulation, historically cycle lows; long
ETH discount (MVRV<1) with active addresses above their 90d norm: value plus returning demand, which should avoid dead-chain drawdowns; long
ETH: active addresses well below 90d norm (z<-1) in a downtrend means users leaving while price falls, no demand floor; short
BTC short: sentiment collapse - F&G 30%+ below its own 30d mean while trend not yet down marks a greedy market breaking (corrected ma_ratio scale, centred on 0)
BTC short: greed without a trend - F&G>=70 while regime is range or down is optimism unsupported by price; fade
BTC short: bear rally with no new dollars - F&G>=50 in downtrend AND stablecoin supply shrinking over 90d
BTC short: stalling liquidity in a downtrend - stablecoin 30d growth under 1% (tide not rising) and sentiment still not fearful (F&G>=40): no capitulation yet, no new bid
Structural bear: BTC below its 365d mean and below its 30d mean; shorts only pay in a true bear market, not in bull-market dips
Quiet bear drift: ETH below its 180d mean with low realised vol (30d under 3%) grinds lower without the violent squeezes that hurt shorts
Realised-vol targeting on the breakout: BTC RSI breakout in up regime only while 30d vol is under 4%, skipping blow-off phases where drawdowns come from
ETH outsized 7d up move (+1 sigma vchg) in an uptrend marks a momentum ignition that continues; vol-normalised so it adapts to ETH regimes better than RSI
ETH short in a downtrend when ETH implied vol has dropped 20% in 30d: vol sellers return and hedges come off while the trend is still down, so the bleed resumes unprotected
ETH short when ETH vol is elevated but BTC vol is not (eth pctile>=0.5, btc pctile<0.5): ETH-specific stress not shared by the complex, approximating a wide ETH-BTC vol spread
ETH short on compressed ETH vol in an uptrend only: a rally with no option demand behind it is exhausted; up was the best regime for the compressed-vol short
ETH short when ETH implied vol is below its 90d average and still slipping in a downtrend (ma_ratio 90 < 0.9): slow grind lower without fear
ETH long: greed in an uptrend is momentum (same mechanism as BTC champion): F&G>=60, ETH trend up
ETH long: liquidity tide - stablecoin supply growing 30d in an ETH uptrend; stablecoins live mostly on ETH rails so growth is direct demand
ETH long: extreme fear with dry powder arriving - F&G<25 while stablecoin supply still growing over 30d; contrarian, any regime
ETH long: DeFi TVL growing 10%+ over 30d in an uptrend - capital is being deployed on-chain, reflexive demand for ETH collateral
Puell multiple under 0.5 (miner revenue 50% below its 365d mean; ma_ratio is centred so -0.5): miner income stress marks cycle lows; long
BTC on-chain USD transfer volume spike (z90>=2) outside an uptrend is coins moving to sell: distribution/panic participation without trend support; short
ETH deeper discount: MVRV<0.8 means the average holder is 20%+ under water, seller exhaustion, historically only at cycle lows; long
ETH fee spike (z90>=2) outside an uptrend: gas mania or liquidation-driven congestion without trend support marks blow-offs; short (same idea that held on BTC)
ETH long: uptrend greed momentum confirmed by liquidity - F&G>=60 and stablecoin supply up over 30d; should cut the drawdown from rallies on shrinking dollars
ETH long: uptrend greed momentum with DeFi TVL expanding over 30d - on-chain capital deployment confirms ETH-specific demand, not just BTC-led sentiment
ETH long: stronger greed (F&G>=70) in uptrend - if greed is momentum, more greed should be more momentum; tests whether 60 is a soft floor
ETH short in an ETH uptrend while BTC implied vol is compressed: complex-wide complacency, ETH rallies without vol demand fade; BTC vol as the cleaner gauge

ETH short on compressed and still-falling ETH vol in up/range (pctile<0.3, roc30<0): deepening complacency, mirror of the kept BTC short structure but in the regimes where ETH compressed-vol shorts earned
ETH long when ETH implied vol is rising fast (30d roc >= 0.2) in an uptrend: vol expansion with trend is upside chase, dynamic version of the kept high-pctile rule
ETH long in an uptrend when both ETH and BTC implied vol are in their top 30%: complex-wide vol expansion in an uptrend is broad upside demand, stricter than ETH vol alone
Low-volume drift lower: BTC below its 90d mean while volume is below its 30d average means no capitulation yet, so the decline continues; short in down or range
Compression in a downtrend resolves lower: ETH daily range in the bottom quarter of its 90d distribution while price is below its 50d mean; short
Vol targeting on the ETH breakout: RSI 65+ in up regime only while 30d realised vol is under 5%, skipping blow-off phases as worked for BTC
Range expansion on volume: BTC in up regime with volume above its 30d average and price above its 20d mean is a participation-backed advance; long
ETH long: contrarian fear with dry powder, gated to range/down where exp23 table earned (up days lost): F&G<25, stablecoin 30d growth positive
ETH short: bear rally with no new dollars (BTC short champion mechanism): F&G>=50 in ETH downtrend and stablecoin supply shrinking over 90d
ETH short: complacency in an ETH downtrend - F&G>=50 (market-wide sentiment still fine, driven by BTC) while ETH itself trends down: relative weakness continues
ETH short: liquidity ebb - stablecoin supply contracting over 30d in an ETH downtrend
Puell under 0.5 is a capitulation marker, so it belongs to range/down markets; the few uptrend days are post-halving revenue cuts, not stress. Gate to range/down
BTC hash rate falling over 30d in a downtrend = miners switching off and selling treasury to cover costs, ongoing capitulation pressure; short
ETH deep discount (MVRV<0.8) once MVRV stopped falling over 30d: deepest value plus seller exhaustion, should cut the drawdown of either alone; long
ETH: MVRV dropping fast vs its 90d norm (z<-1) in a downtrend means holders are being pushed into loss and capitulating; short with the trend
BTC short in a downtrend when BTC implied vol is below 50 vol points in absolute terms: a bleed nobody is paying to hedge; raw level avoids the rolling-window dependence
BTC short in a downtrend when vol is compressed on a 1-year lookback and falling over 30d: same complacent-bleed idea as the champion with a longer window to check it is not a 180d artefact
BTC long on vol expansion vs the 180d mean (z180 >= 1) in up/range: same idea as the champion on a longer baseline, to check the edge is not specific to the 90d window
ETH long in an uptrend when ETH implied vol is in the top 30% of the past year: longer lookback version of the champion, expansion relative to a full cycle of vol
ETH short: relief-rally fade - F&G one sigma above its 30d mean (z>=1) while ETH trend is down: a sentiment pop inside a downtrend tends to fail
ETH short: complacency plus DeFi capital leaving - F&G>=50 in ETH downtrend while DeFi TVL is down over 30d: on-chain deleveraging not yet reflected in sentiment
ETH short: no capitulation and no new bid - F&G>=40 with stablecoin 30d growth under 1% in an ETH downtrend (BTC variant scored 0.27 with two positive folds)
ETH short: greed (F&G>=60) while ETH is already in a downtrend - sentiment led by BTC, ETH lagging; strongest form of the complacency fade
BTC short when OKX perp open interest has grown 20% in 30d inside a non-uptrend: leverage building without price follow-through gets flushed; expected thin or invalid since okx:oi starts 2024-02
ETH short in an uptrend when both ETH and BTC implied vol are compressed: complex-wide complacency behind an ETH rally, two gauges agreeing
BTC long all-clear: implied vol still high (top 30% of 180d) but falling over 7d, in down/range: the panic has peaked and sellers are done
BTC long on vol expansion confirmed by ETH (both DVOL z90 >= 1) in up/range: complex-wide upside chase rather than a BTC-only event
Robustness of the Puell idea at a looser round threshold (revenue 40% under its 365d mean): if miner-stress is real the neighbour should also earn, on more days
BTC MVRV far above its yearly norm (z365>=2) once the trend has stalled (range/down): stretched unrealised profit with no momentum invites distribution; short
ETH fee pressure above norm (fees z90>=1) in an uptrend while valuation is still modest (MVRV<1.5): real blockspace demand early in a bull leg; long
ETH transfer-count spike (z90>=2) outside an uptrend: coins rushing to exchanges, panic participation; short (analogue of BTC transfer-volume spike)
Quiet bear range: the low-vol ETH short earned only in range regime (lost in down, where bounces come); gate it to range
Bear-market range fade: BTC below its 180d mean and below its 20d mean while the regime is range (not yet oversold-down, where bounces punish shorts)
ETH breakout only in a structural bull: RSI 65+ in up regime with price above its 365d mean, dropping bear-market rallies that fail (weak middle fold)
ETH stronger breakout: RSI 70+ in up regime; a stricter round threshold keeps only the most persistent thrusts and less time in market
BTC calm breakout also in range regime: the vol filter should remove the counter-trend spikes that caused drawdown, and range breakouts had Sharpe 1.3
BTC short: complacency plus DeFi capital leaving (ETH short champion mechanism, more in-market days than the 29-day BTC champion): F&G>=50, TVL down over 30d, downtrend
ETH short: slower risk-off gauge - F&G>=50 in ETH downtrend with DeFi TVL down over 90d: sustained capital exit rather than a 30d dip
ETH short: both liquidity gauges ebbing under complacent sentiment - F&G>=50, DeFi TVL down 30d, stablecoin 30d growth negative, downtrend
ETH long all-clear: ETH implied vol still high (top 30% of 180d) but falling over 7d, in down/range: panic has peaked; the BTC version scored positive in both folds
ETH long in an uptrend when ETH implied vol is in the top 30% of the past 90d: shorter lookback of the champion, reacts sooner to a vol expansion
BTC short in a downtrend when BTC vol is compressed and falling and ETH vol is compressed too: complex-wide complacent bleed, ETH confirming the champion signal
ETH short in an uptrend when ETH implied vol is 1 sigma below its 90d mean: z-score form of the compressed-vol rally fade, to see if it holds outside the pctile definition
BTC long: stronger greed (F&G>=70) in uptrend - on ETH this cut drawdown at similar Sharpe; checks the 60 floor is not a tuned peak
ETH long: uptrend greed momentum on a rising slow liquidity tide - F&G>=60 with stablecoin supply up over 90d; filters late rallies after dollars stopped arriving
Simpler form of the ETH fee-demand rule: fees above norm (z90>=1) in an uptrend without the MVRV cap; if the cap adds nothing the one-condition rule should win
BTC analogue of fee demand: fees above 90d norm (z>=1) in an uptrend with modest valuation (MVRV<1.5) is real blockspace demand early in a bull leg; long
Puell high: miner revenue double its 365d mean (ma_ratio>=1) is miner euphoria and heavy miner selling into strength; once trend stalls (range/down) short
ETH: profit cushion (MVRV>=1.5) that is shrinking over 30d once trend is no longer up (range/down): distribution under way, more days than the down-only champion; short
Post-parabolic break: BTC up 50%+ over 90 days and now closing below its 20d mean marks a blow-off losing support; late longs unwind, short
Post-parabolic break ETH: up 50%+ over 90 days and now below its 20d mean; blow-off losing support, short
Crash onset: ETH realised vol high (30d at 5%+) with price below its 20d mean; volatility clusters and high-vol declines extend before they exhaust
Slower thrust for ETH: 30d RSI at 60+ in up regime is a smoother persistent-buying signal with fewer whipsaws than the 14d
Robustness neighbour of the BTC champion: RSI 70+ with the same vol cap in up regime; if the edge is real a stricter thrust keeps Sharpe with less exposure
BTC falling through aggregate cost basis: MVRV<1 and still dropping over 30d in a downtrend is the capitulation cascade before exhaustion (mirror of the long rule that waits for roc>=0); short
BTC transfer-volume spike earned only in downtrends and lost in range per the regime table: in a downtrend a volume spike is coins moving to sell; gate to down only
ETH profit cushion (MVRV>=1.5) in a downtrend with fee demand below its 90d norm (z<0): holders have profit to sell and no blockspace demand to absorb it; short
Crash onset inside an uptrend: ETH high realised vol (5%+) and a close below the 20d mean while the regime label still says up is the start of a leveraged unwind; the high-vol short earned only there
Crash onset inside an uptrend, BTC: realised vol 4%+ and a close below the 20d mean while regime is still up marks a leveraged unwind starting
Faster thrust for ETH: 7d RSI at 70+ in up regime enters and exits sooner than the 14d, cutting time spent in the fading part of a move
Robustness neighbour of the BTC champion on the loose side: RSI 60+ with the 4% vol cap in up regime; more days in market, checks the edge is not a threshold artefact
Quiet bear range, BTC: below the 180d mean with 30d realised vol under 3% in range regime grinds lower without squeezes; the only short pocket that was positive on ETH
Wider sample of the ETH crash-onset short: realised vol 4%+ (round, looser) and below the 20d mean in up regime; if the effect is real it should survive more days
ETH calm breakout in the exact BTC champion form: RSI 65+ with 30d vol under 4% in up regime; cross-asset consistency of the vol-targeted thrust
